name: Analyze Reusable Packages

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - release/**
    paths:
      - "**"
      - "*"
      - ".globalconfig"
      - "!.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**"
      - "!.dependabot/config.yml"
      - "!.pipelines/**"
      - "!test/perf/**"
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
      - release/**
    paths:
      - "**"
      - "*"
      - ".globalconfig"
      - "!.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**"
      - "!.dependabot/config.yml"
      - "!.pipelines/**"
      - "!test/perf/**"

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ contains(github.ref, 'merge')}}

env:
  DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: 1
  DOTNET_NOLOGO: 1
  FORCE_FEATURE: 'False'
  FORCE_PACKAGE: 'False'
  NUGET_KEY: none
  POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: 1
  __SuppressAnsiEscapeSequences: 1
  nugetMultiFeedWarnLevel: none
  system_debug: 'false'

jobs:
  analyze:
    name: Analyze PowerShell Packages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1000

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
        with:
          global-json-file: ./global.json

      - name: Bootstrap
        run: |
          Import-Module ./build.psm1 -Verbose -ErrorAction Stop
          Write-LogGroupStart -Title "Switch to public feed"
          Switch-PSNugetConfig -Source Public
          Write-LogGroupEnd -Title "Switch to public feed"

          Write-LogGroupStart -Title "Bootstrap"
          Start-PSBootstrap -Scenario DotNet
          Write-LogGroupEnd -Title "Bootstrap"

          Write-LogGroupStart -Title "Install .NET Tools"
          Start-PSBootstrap -Scenario Tools
          Write-LogGroupEnd -Title "Install .NET Tools"

          Write-LogGroupStart -Title "Sync Tags"
          Sync-PSTags -AddRemoteIfMissing
          Write-LogGroupEnd -Title "Sync Tags"

          Write-LogGroupStart -Title "Setup .NET environment variables"
          Find-DotNet -SetDotnetRoot
          Write-LogGroupEnd -Title "Setup .NET environment variables"
        shell: pwsh

      - name: Build PowerShell
        run: |
          Import-Module ./build.psm1 -Verbose -ErrorAction Stop
          Start-PSBuild
        shell: pwsh

      - name: Run Package Validation Tests
        run: |
          Import-Module ./build.psm1 -Verbose -ErrorAction Stop
          Invoke-PackageValidationTests
        shell: pwsh

      - name: Package PowerShell
        run: |
          Import-Module ./build.psm1 -Verbose -ErrorAction Stop
          New-Package -Channel stable -Architecture x64
          New-Package -Channel preview -Architecture x64
        shell: pwsh

      - name: Validate DEB Packages
        run: |
          Import-Module ./build.psm1 -Verbose -ErrorAction Stop
          $debPackages = Get-ChildItem -Path ./artifacts -Filter "*.deb" -Recurse
          if ($debPackages.Count -eq 0) {
              throw "No DEB packages found in artifacts directory"
          }
          foreach ($package in $debPackages) {
              Write-Host "Validating package: $($package.FullName)"
              # Validate DEB package structure
              dpkg-deb --info "$($package.FullName)" | Out-Null
              Write-Host "Package validated successfully: $($package.Name)"
          }
        shell: pwsh

      - name: Upload Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: packages
          path: ./artifacts/
          retention-days: 7
